theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $f,h,J,\ell\in\mathbb N$ be cover base, microblock parameter, block count and A-incidence length. Suppose memory $\mu$ satisfies the complete retained cover/key-data contract at $f$. For Light limits, program and depth $\lambda,P,d$, assume the program contains the wanted-header body, addresses fit words and the computed wanted-header address fits memory. Then the call on $(f,J,\ell)$ returns

$$\operatorname{wantedFree}(f,h,J,\ell),$$

within its prescribed $J$-dependent time, leaving all memory unchanged.

This obtains the next physical header from retained construction data rather than external pointer advice.
